title: ClinicalAlert
description: Clinical alert generated by any agent when a patient safety concern is detected. Sources include Pre-Visit risk scoring, Post-Visit red-flag detection, Clinical Triage emergency classification, and Billing anomalies.

alertId.description: Unique clinical alert identifier. Format: ALT-XXXXXXXX.

visitId.description: Reference to the associated Visit, if applicable.

sourceAgent.description: Which agent pillar generated this alert.

alertType.description: Classification of the clinical alert type.

severity.description: Alert severity. Critical = emergency keywords or immediate life threat. High = clinical escalation required within SLA. Medium = follow-up needed. Low = informational.

description.description: Human-readable description of the alert and what triggered it.

detectedKeywords.description: Keywords or phrases that triggered this alert (e.g., 'chest pain', 'can't breathe', 'bleeding').

sourceData.description: Reference data from the source that triggered this alert (e.g., intake form data, post-visit response, triage input).

relevantData.description: Key data points from the source record relevant to the alert.

escalationStatus.description: Current escalation status of the alert.

escalatedTo.description: Role or person the alert was escalated to (e.g., 'nurse-queue', 'physician', 'emergency-services', 'prescribing-doctor').

escalationTicketId.description: Reference to the Escalation Ticket created for this alert.

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp when the alert was resolved.

resolvedBy.description: User ID of the person who resolved the alert.

resolutionNotes.description: Notes on how the alert was resolved.
